messages:
Elle: quick check — I'm about to merge a module rename + provider pin for the legacy stack. Ran `terraform plan` in staging and saw duplicate provider entries in the lockfile and a provider version mismatch warning. Anyone else hitting this?

Elle: snippet of the call change:
```
module "legacy" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//legacy?ref=rename/v2"
  providers = { aws = aws.legacy }
  secret_path = "/secrets/legacy"
}
```

Sam: on it, reproducing locally. Quick tip — when hoisting/renaming modules you can end up with duplicate lockfile entries if provider aliases are unresolved. Running `terraform init -reconfigure` then `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64,linux_arm64` usually regenerates a sane lockfile.

Sam: also seeing the warning: "provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws: version constraint does not match lockfile entry". Looks like the module pins provider = "~> 3.0" but our root pins = "= 4.3.1". That's the source of the mismatch.

Jordan: FYI if you rename the module path you will need `terraform state mv module.legacy module.legacy_v2` in staging to avoid resource recreation. Otherwise plan will try to delete and recreate.

Jordan: also double-check the k8s secret wiring — module output changed from `legacy_secret_name` to `secret_name_v2`. The service config in k8s/staging references the old name, so update the manifest or pass the output through the module call.

Maya: can we canary this to staging with pinned provider? I opened a PR: https://git.company/infra/PR/412 — @Sam can you sanity-check the provider change and lockfile regen when you have a sec?

terraform-plan-bot: plan for PR #412 finished — 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. Warnings: provider version constraints differ from lockfile; see plan details: https://ci.company/plan/412

Sam: I updated root providers.tf to `required_providers { aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "= 4.3.1" } }` and re-ran `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64,linux_arm64`. Also adjusted module call to forward `secret_path = var.secret_path` so we don't hardcode.

Sam: pushed lockfile regen commit and kicked CI. @Maya please re-run the staging plan job.

Elle: I ran the staging canary. No drift, no recreations. Plan is clean. Approving merge. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Adding a quick runbook note about secret rotation and the changed path — will file a ticket for ops to update any downstream integrations.

Maya: LGTM, merging now. Thanks all.
